params.doc: Bytes of raw body and rendered DOM captured per article.
Largest response body the digest host's audited fetch reads.

UTF-8 bytes of article text the digest stores per story, as one retained report (static clip and evidence check); the analyst reads at most ext.hnDigest.articleAnalystReadMaxBytes of it. The browser worker's own clip (browser.capture.textMaxBytes) may not exceed it.
UTF-8 bytes of one article page the digest publishes to the analyst (a page is a view of the stored text, never the verification authority).

UTF-8 bytes of the stored article text the digest offers the analyst, as pages; the first pages that fit are published and the rest is named as unread. Quotes still verify against the whole stored text.
Deadline the digest's browser worker requests for one article capture.
Largest rendered digest report the digest workflows publish (the content workflow's report bound and the metadata digest's report capability).
